segments.name: Automobile Transaction and Related Services
segments.description: Provides automobile operating leases, auto financing and related services to ride-hailing drivers in China.
segments.evidence: We operate our business in one segment: Automobile Transaction and Related Services (as defined herein below), which constituted a series of services as follows:

revenueModel.text: Lessees and automobile purchasers pay for leases, financing, services and default fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Automobile purchase services are paid by automobile purchasers for a series of the services we provided to them throughout the purchase process such as credit assessment, installment of GPS devices, ride-hailing driver qualification and other administrative procedures, which are based on the sales price of the automobiles and relevant services provided.

changes.text: The online ride-hailing platform segment was discontinued in 2024 after its sale.
changes.evidence: On August 20, 2024, the Acquisition was completed and Senmiao disposed of its 100% equity interest in XXTX and its subsidiaries to the Purchaser, effectively discontinued our operations in the online ride-hailing platform service segment.

changes.text: The Sichuan automobile transaction services were disposed of in 2025.
changes.evidence: On December 31, 2025, the Disposition was completed and we ceased our automobile Transactions and Related Services in Sichuan Province of China.
